items.question: How much x402 activity is real commerce?
items.context: Raw counts, Visa and Artemis adjusted figures and academic counts disagree by an order of magnitude. The x402.org counter showed the same values from at least 2025-12-14 until it was removed after 2026-10-24. On 2026-11-14 x402scan showed about $1.89M for its 30-day view, while agenteconomy.to counted about 200.2M cumulative transactions and about $274,000 for October 2026; agenteconomy.to states its counting basis (on-chain settlements from 18 tracked facilitators) but does not label wash activity. Artemis keeps its detection logic private and arXiv:2607.12575 uses its own method; no shared, published labeling method was found on 2026-11-14.

items.question: Will a2a-x402 be updated for AP2 v0.2?
items.context: The a2a-x402 v0.2 embedded flow puts requirements in an AP2 v0.1 CartMandate, which AP2 v0.2 no longer has. The two transport specs also use different extension URIs.

items.question: Can payment and delivery be made atomic?
items.context: Each payment flow shifts risk to one side. A402 proposes Atomic Service Channels; auth-capture adds refunds but not proof of delivery.

items.question: How decentralized will facilitation be in practice?
items.context: Anyone can run a facilitator, and supply has widened: Circle has run a hosted facilitator since 2026-09-16, Brave has run its own for its Search API since 2026-11-12, and Tempo has run one since 2026-11-19 that takes USDC on Base and pays sellers in OUSD on Tempo, so the buyer signs a payment to Tempo's address and the seller relies on Tempo for the payout. Yet in arXiv:2607.19545's sample (Base and Solana, 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-26) Coinbase's handled 77.17M of about 119.7M x402 transactions, and two edge services settle through it: the Cloudflare Monetization Gateway and, since 2026-06-15, the AI traffic monetization of AWS WAF. No newer concentration measurement was found on 2026-11-14. The eight facilitator security rules from that paper are not part of the spec.

items.question: What will the identity, tax and card-acceptance working groups produce?
items.context: The x402 Foundation has wg-identity, wg-tax, wg-card-acceptance and wg-domain-discovery repositories. On 2026-10-19 the identity, tax and card-acceptance repositories held only a README and a license, and the domain-discovery group had merged a draft verifier response schema on 2026-10-02. The draft card binding for auth-capture (x402 PR #3707) merged on 2026-11-12 into the feature branch feat/auth-capture-card, not into main; a draft pull request to main (#4241) was open on 2026-11-14, so cards are not part of the specification on main.

items.question: Will SDK parity catch up?
items.context: On 2026-11-14 TypeScript listed 14 network families (13 published on npm), Go had added casper and Python cardano and the client payment hooks. No SDK implements the Lightning binding; Python lacks auth-capture and Solana upto and batch-settlement; offer-receipt is TypeScript only; the Java module is unpublished; x402-a2a is not on PyPI.

items.question: Should payment metadata be minimized by the spec?
items.context: Resource URLs and descriptions reach facilitators that may not have data agreements with payers; research proposes filtering middleware, but the spec has no rule.

items.question: Will the maintainers publish advisories and CVE identifiers for SDK security fixes, and when will the foundation's bug bounty start?
items.context: The three maintainer advisories, two rated high and one medium (GHSA-5cgh-j82v-jvrj of 2026-11-18), still had no CVE id on 2026-11-21; that day the medium one listed no patched version and had no entry in the GitHub Advisory Database or OSV. CVE-2026-113603 (2026-10-20) came from a third-party CNA, and GitHub lists it as unreviewed with no package mapping. V12's three critical findings and the paywall script-injection fix of 2026-10-22 shipped without an advisory. Since 2026-10-15 SECURITY.md routes vulnerability reports to the x402 Foundation (a TSC member or a primary maintainer, privately through the x402 Slack) and says a bug bounty program is coming soon.
